body: Hi there! Thanks for the report. I've queued this for a reproduction check on Wails v3. We'll keep this open while we investigate.

Hi there! I reproduced this on macOS. A fix is queued. Thanks!

<details>
<summary>Test evidence</summary>

Tested 3a83b2c65b ([pinned source](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/commit/3a83b2c65b76a89e3d47c33acd0cf5ddbe48df3b)). Each VM started from its clean test snapshot and ran offline.

Trigger: After the measured initial baseline, call window.ZoomIn() six times through the Wails API, observe the live DOM viewport/layout values once the zoom effect is visibly applied, then call ZoomReset() and observe again until the baseline is restored.

Expected: Browser-style page zoom: documentElement.clientWidth shrinks to roughly 800/1.3 ~= 615 CSS px, the paragraph reflows to more line rects, visualViewport.scale stays ~1.00, the right-edge marker stays within the visible viewport, and ZoomReset restores the initial baseline.

**macOS 26.6.2 ARM64 — reproduced**

```text
go build ./workflow-repro; run reviewed native Wails GUI probe (50-second application deadline)
ProductVersion:		26.6.2
BuildVersion:		25G83
go version go1.27.1 darwin/arm64
REPRO_READY: initial-page positive control measured
REPRO_OBSERVATION: initial clientWidth=800.0 vvWidth=800.0 vvScale=1.00 lines=10 rightEdge=776.0
REPRO_OBSERVATION: trigger clientWidth=800.0 vvWidth=615.4 vvScale=1.30 lines=10 rightEdge=776.0
REPRO_OBSERVATION: reset clientWidth=800.0 vvWidth=800.0 vvScale=1.00 lines=10 rightEdge=776.0
REPRO_ASSERTION: expected viewportShrinks=true actual viewportShrinks=false | expected lines>10 actual lines=10 | expected clientWidth<800.0 actual clientWidth=800.0 | expected vvScale<=1.00 actual vvScale=1.30 | expected rightEdge<=clientWidth=800.0 actual rightEdge=776.0 | expected resetOK=true actual resetOK=true
```

The failing regression assertion is the evidence; compilation and setup succeeded.

Scope: a running native Wails window against this pinned source, with measured DOM/native observations. This does not establish behavior on other OS releases, Wails versions or untested interactions. Only the trigger and measurements listed above were tested. 

Revision selection: reported public commit. Results apply only to the pinned source and OS shown; an inferred version is not attributed to the reporter.

Independent evidence review agreed with these results.

</details>
